Character sprites extracted from Yakimochi Stream (ヤキモチストリーム).

Due to the large number of sprite assets and possible expression combinations, the complete character sprite collection has been divided into four galleries.

Parts 1–3 contain all character sprites that actually appear in the game, as well as unused base sprite assets combined only with expression variants that are valid according to the game's original composition rules.

This gallery is Part 4 of 4. It contains adult/H sprite base variants that exist in the game resources but are not actually used in the game, combined with valid expression variants defined by the game's sprite composition system.

从《ヤキモチストリーム（Yakimochi Stream）》游戏资源中提取的人物立绘。

由于本作立绘素材及可组合的表情差分数量较多，完整的人物立绘合集共分为四个画廊上传。

第一至第三卷收录游戏中实际出现过的全部人物立绘，同时收录游戏资源中存在但未实际使用的立绘底图，并仅按照游戏原始合成规则生成合法的表情组合。

本画廊为第四卷，也是最后一卷。
本卷主要收录游戏资源中存在、但实际游戏中未使用的成人向／H 立绘底图，并按照游戏原始立绘合成规则与有效表情差分进行组合。
